section.title: Listening ports
section.p: The admin console listens on port 8443.
The REST API listens on port 8443.
The health probe is served on port 8443 and answers only to requests from the management subnet.
Metrics are exposed on port 8443 in Prometheus text format.
Open port 8443 for inbound TLS traffic, and close it again once the migration is complete.
